title: upready.shop-summary/v1 — the totals one sales source (a shop's storefront or one of its marketplace accounts) hands to the owner's «Сводка» on the other instance
description: t-2026-10-20-23. The only shape that crosses between the RU and the INTL instance. Totals only: sums, counts, the shop's own product titles, review counts by star. No buyer's name, e-mail, phone, address, order number, review text or review author, and no free text a buyer wrote. Every object is closed (additionalProperties: false), so a field this file does not name is refused by the relay before anything leaves the host. Amounts are in the currency's main unit, the way Medusa 2 stores them (4990 = 4 990 ₽). The shapes of a period follow GET /tenants/analytics/summary (apps/tenant-panel/src/hooks/api/analytics-summary.ts), one row per currency in its own currency (b12-analytics-accuracy); `fx` carries the rate the owner's page uses to show them in rubles (Ivan 21.10, mark 17 on prototype v2).

instance.description: Which deployment computed the totals: ru = cherkashino.ru on the RU host, intl = the Contabo host.

source.description: Where the sales of these totals happen: the shop's own storefront, or a marketplace account the shop has connected in «Торговые площадки» (Ivan 20.10, mark 1 on prototype v1: «Источники продаж», with Wildberries and Ozon in the list). A marketplace source belongs to the shop in `shop`; its totals are computed by the instance that holds the marketplace connection.

seq.description: Grows by one with every payload of this shop. The receiver keeps the last one and refuses a payload whose seq is not larger (replay).

generated_at.description: When the backend computed the totals, UTC.

owner_sub.description: The owner's identity as the RU identity home issues it: an opaque id, not an e-mail. The receiver shows the totals only to a login linked to this id.

timezone.description: The shop's own time zone; «today» and the days of `daily` are cut in it.

periods.description: The periods of the bar (Ivan 21.10, mark 15 on prototype v2: «чтобы работал переключатель»). `range` is the owner's own range from the bar's calendar, present when the request names one (?from=&to=).

daily.description: Revenue and orders by day for the last 90 days, one row per day and currency, days without orders left out. Enough for the chart and for any range inside 90 days.

hourly.description: Revenue and orders by hour for today and yesterday, the chart of a one-day period; one row per hour and currency, hours without orders left out.

monthly.description: Revenue and orders by calendar month over the days of the «365d» period, the year's chart: the first and the last month are partial, the months add up to the period. One row per month and currency.

fx.description: The rate at which the owner's page shows this source's amounts in the display currency. An amount stays in its own currency everywhere in this payload; the page multiplies it by the rate and names the real amount, the rate and its date in a tooltip. One rate per currency for every period: the Bank of Russia's rate set for the day the totals were computed.

display_currency.description: The one currency the owner's page shows (Ivan 21.10, mark 17: «показывать в рублях»).

source.description: cbr = the official rate of the Bank of Russia (cbr.ru, XML_daily).

rates.description: One row per currency of this payload other than the display currency; empty when everything sold in rubles.

to_pack.description: Paid orders not yet handed to delivery — the counter of «Заказы» in the side menu.

reviews.description: Counts only. No text, no author, no date of a single review.

average_rating.description: Over published reviews; null when there are none.

name.description: The shop's own name, as in the panel header.

panel_url.description: Where the «…» switch sends the owner for this shop.

currencies.description: One row per currency the period holds; the shop's main currency is always present, as a real zero when nothing sold.

top_products.description: At most five, by revenue in their currency. The title is the shop's catalogue, never a buyer's words.

previous.description: The period of the same length just before, for the change in percent; for «today», yesterday up to the same hour.

hour.description: The day and the hour in the shop's time zone, 2026-10-20T09 = 09:00–09:59.

rate.description: Rubles for one unit of the currency, as the Bank of Russia publishes it (94.37 = 1 € is 94,37 ₽).

date.description: The day the Bank of Russia set the rate for.
